tools.name: catalog.list
tools.description: List every commodity instrument in the catalog with sector, unit, primary source, and freshness metadata. Call this first to discover valid codes before price.latest or inventory.get. Free discovery tool — no payment required.

tools.name: price.latest
tools.description: Return the latest cash/fundies observation for one instrument code. Use catalog.list to discover codes such as CL, GC, or ZC. Response follows the shared observation contract with provenance and license tags.

tools.name: observation.resolve
tools.description: Resolve a single observation by its id. Derived observations (crack, crush, basis) cite the observations they were computed from in inputs[]; this is how you dereference those ids to audit a derived value. Ids look like obs_<24 hex>.

tools.name: inventory.get
tools.description: Fetch EIA weekly petroleum inventory levels. Omit series to list all latest inventory points, or pass a series key to get week-over-week change, vs-5y deviation, and a surprise label for that series.

tools.name: positioning.get
tools.description: Return the latest CFTC Commitments of Traders managed-money positioning for an instrument code. Includes long, short, net, and week-over-week net change with source URL.

tools.name: spread.get
tools.description: Compute a derived spread observation: 3-2-1 crack, soybean crush, or WTI-Brent basis (paid). type=calendar is a free Phase-2 stub that returns available=false until licensed curves exist. Prefer crack/crush/basis for live derived values with formula and inputs.

tools.name: price.history
tools.description: Return historical observations for an instrument code (up to 500 points). Use after price.latest when you need a short time series for the same code.

tools.name: fx.latest
tools.description: Return the latest FX rate observation for a pair or FRED FX series. Useful alongside commodity prices when converting cash values across currencies.

tools.name: fundamentals.get
tools.description: Fetch a fundamentals document: USDA WASDE, crop progress, export sales, or USGS mineral summaries. Choose kind based on the ags/metals question you are answering.

tools.name: snapshot.get
tools.description: Build a sector snapshot bundling prices, inventories, spreads, and related fundies for energy, metals, ags, or all sectors. Prefer this over calling many single-observation tools when you need a full sector picture.

tools.name: calendar.get
tools.description: List EIA, USDA, and CFTC release calendar entries with cadence, typical Eastern time, next_hint prose, and next_release_at ISO date (America/New_York). Free discovery tool — call before scheduling agents around inventory or WASDE prints.

tools.name: decision.get
tools.description: Build a deterministic decision pack for energy, metals, ags, or all sectors. Returns method, signals with direction/rationale, an embedded snapshot, and a disclaimer — no ML model, rule-based only.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "price.latest" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
